subject.title: fix(auth): bind OAuth and sessions to immutable identity

question: Should existing email-owned sessions and durable owner records be migrated through an explicit, verified administrator-controlled path, or intentionally invalidated with a documented operator recovery procedure?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes persisted ownership semantics and can remove access from existing users; code review cannot choose the repository's acceptable migration and access-loss policy.

options.title: Add a controlled migration path
options.body: Preserve existing access only after an explicit verified mapping from the legacy owner to the immutable GitHub account, with upgrade and mismatch coverage.

options.title: Accept fail-closed invalidation
options.body: Keep automatic invalidation, but publish an operator recovery procedure and make the compatibility break an explicit approved release decision.

recommendation.title: Add a controlled migration path
recommendation.body: Preserve existing access only after an explicit verified mapping from the legacy owner to the immutable GitHub account, with upgrade and mismatch coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed implementation and can incorporate the selected policy, though repository leadership must approve the direction.
